Name: Cybersecurity strategy, Policies for information security and regular review of policies
Notes: The cybersecurity strategy must define the objectives that need to be achieved based on the results of the cybersecurity risk analysis. It also establishes the fundamental principles for achieving these objectives and specifies the authorities and responsibilities for management systems, cybersecurity risk management, and the updating of security documentation. A set of information security policies, including topic-specific policies, is defined, approved by management, published, communicated to relevant personnel and external parties, acknowledged by the intended audience, and reviewed regularly and upon significant changes.
EN Name: Cybersecurity strategy, Policies for information security and regular review of policies
EN Notes: The cybersecurity strategy must define the objectives that need to be achieved based on the results of the cybersecurity risk analysis. It also establishes the fundamental principles for achieving these objectives and specifies the authorities and responsibilities for management systems, cybersecurity risk management, and the updating of security documentation. A set of information security policies, including topic-specific policies, is defined, approved by management, published, communicated to relevant personnel and external parties, acknowledged by the intended audience, and reviewed regularly and upon significant changes.
SK Name: Stratégia kybernetickej bezpečnosti, politiky informačnej bezpečnosti a pravidelné preskúmanie politík
SK Notes: Stratégia kybernetickej bezpečnosti musí definovať ciele, ktoré je potrebné dosiahnuť na základe výsledkov analýzy kybernetických rizík. Zároveň stanovuje základné princípy na dosiahnutie týchto cieľov a určuje právomoci a zodpovednosti za riadiace systémy, riadenie kybernetických rizík a aktualizáciu bezpečnostnej dokumentácie. Je definovaný súbor politík informačnej bezpečnosti, vrátane politík zameraných na konkrétne témy, ktorý schvaľuje vedenie. Politiky sú zverejnené, komunikované príslušnému personálu a externým stranám, a je potvrdené oboznámenie sa. Následne sú politiky pravidelne revidované, prípadne sú revidované pri každej významnej  zmene.

Name: Information security roles and responsibilities
Notes: Information security roles and responsibilities are defined and allocated according to the organization needs. The assignment of responsibility for information security to all employees through the formal organisational structure.
EN Notes: Information security roles and responsibilities are defined and allocated according to the organization needs. The assignment of responsibility for information security to all employees through the formal organisational structure.
SK Name: Roly a zodpovednosti v informačnej bezpečnosti
SK Notes: Roly a zodpovednosti v oblasti informačnej bezpečnosti sú definované a pridelené podľa potrieb organizácie. Priradenie zodpovednosti za informačnú bezpečnosť všetkým zamestnancom prostredníctvom formálnej organizačnej štruktúry.

Name: Segregation of duties
Notes: Conflicting duties and conflicting areas of responsibility are segregated, e.g. administration of OS vs. DB  and network administration, security monitoring vs. IT administration etc.
EN Notes: Conflicting duties and conflicting areas of responsibility are segregated, e.g. administration of OS vs. DB  and network administration, security monitoring vs. IT administration etc.
SK Notes: Konfliktné povinnosti a oblasti zodpovednosti sú oddelené, napr. administrácia operačného systému vs. administrácia databázy alebo správa siete, bezpečnostné monitorovanie vs. IT administrácia a pod.

Name: Management responsibilities
Notes: Management must be fully involved in the information security program, and all employees and contractors must be familiar with the information security policy and adhere to it. Management requires all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy, topic-specific policies, and procedures of the organization.
EN Notes: Management must be fully involved in the information security program, and all employees and contractors must be familiar with the information security policy and adhere to it. Management requires all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy, topic-specific policies, and procedures of the organization.
SK Notes: Vedenie musí byť plne zapojené do programu informačnej bezpečnosti a všetci zamestnanci a dodávatelia musia byť oboznámení s politikou informačnej bezpečnosti a riadiť sa ňou. Vedenie vyžaduje, aby všetok personál uplatňoval zásady informačnej bezpečnosti v súlade so stanovenou politikou, špecifickými politikami týkajúcimi sa konkrétnych oblastí a postupmi organizácie.

Name: Contact with authorities
Notes: The organization establishes and keeps communication with relevant authorities to share important information regarding security threats, trends, defense tactics, etc.
EN Notes: The organization establishes and keeps communication with relevant authorities to share important information regarding security threats, trends, defense tactics, etc.
SK Notes: Organizácia vytvára a udržiava komunikáciu s príslušnými orgánmi za účelom zdieľania dôležitých informácií o bezpečnostných hrozbách, trendoch, obranných taktikách a podobne.

Name: Contact with special interest groups
Notes: The organization keeps contact with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations to share important information regarding security threats, trends, defense tactics, etc.
EN Notes: The organization keeps contact with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations to share important information regarding security threats, trends, defense tactics, etc.
SK Notes: Organizácia udržiava kontakt so špeciálnymi záujmovými skupinami, odbornými bezpečnostnými fórami a profesijnými asociáciami za účelom zdieľania dôležitých informácií o bezpečnostných hrozbách, trendoch, obranných taktikách a podobne.

Name: Threat intelligence
Notes: The collection, analysis, and contextualization of data and information about current and future cyber attacks. An example of threat intelligence is identifying the tactics, techniques, and procedures attackers use to gain access to networks or compromise targets.
EN Notes: The collection, analysis, and contextualization of data and information about current and future cyber attacks. An example of threat intelligence is identifying the tactics, techniques, and procedures attackers use to gain access to networks or compromise targets.
SK Notes: Zber, analýza a kontextualizácia údajov a informácií o aktuálnych a budúcich kybernetických útokoch. Príkladom threat intelligence je identifikácia taktík, techník a postupov, ktoré útočníci využívajú na získanie prístupu do sietí alebo na kompromitáciu cieľov.

Name: Information security in project management
Notes: Implementation of information security policies into project management within the organisation. Project management must incorporate measures to protect information security and ensure effective risk management in projects and deliverables during project management. It is recommended to use a simple, repeatable checklist that demonstrates information security has been considered.
EN Notes: Implementation of information security policies into project management within the organisation. Project management must incorporate measures to protect information security and ensure effective risk management in projects and deliverables during project management. It is recommended to use a simple, repeatable checklist that demonstrates information security has been considered.
SK Notes: Implementácia politík informačnej bezpečnosti do riadenia projektov v organizácii. Riadenie projektov musí zahŕňať opatrenia na ochranu informačnej bezpečnosti a zabezpečiť efektívne riadenie rizík v projektoch a výstupoch počas riadenia projektov. Odporúča sa použiť jednoduchý, opakovateľný kontrolný zoznam, ktorý preukazuje, že informačná bezpečnosť bola zohľadnená.

Name: User end point devices and mobile devices security
Notes: Creating and maintaining policies, procedures, and technical measures (e.g. EDR/XDR) at the organizational level to protect and ensure the security, confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets stored on or accessible from user endpoint devices.
EN Name: User end point devices and mobile devices security
EN Notes: Creating and maintaining policies, procedures, and technical measures (e.g. EDR/XDR) at the organizational level to protect and ensure the security, confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets stored on or accessible from user endpoint devices.
SK Name: Bezpečnosť koncových zariadení používateľov a mobilných zariadení
SK Notes: Vytváranie a udržiavanie politík, postupov a technických opatrení (napr. EDR/XDR) na úrovni organizácie na ochranu a zaistenie bezpečnosti, dôvernosti, integrity a dostupnosti informačných aktív, ktoré sú uložené alebo prístupné z koncových zariadení používateľov.

Name: Remote working policies and controls
Notes: A policy implemented to ensure secure access to information systems and networks while working remotely. For example, by implementing an information security management system that includes procedures for protecting remote access. VPN clients, cryptography, blocking ports and other security controls can be used.
EN Notes: A policy implemented to ensure secure access to information systems and networks while working remotely. For example, by implementing an information security management system that includes procedures for protecting remote access. VPN clients, cryptography, blocking ports and other security controls can be used.
SK Name: Politiky a opatrenia práce na diaľku
SK Notes: Politika zavedená na zabezpečenie bezpečného prístupu k informačným systémom a sieťam pri práci na diaľku. Napríklad implementovaním systému riadenia informačnej bezpečnosti, ktorý zahŕňa postupy na ochranu vzdialeného prístupu, napr. VPN klienti, šifrovanie, blokovanie portov a ďalšie bezpečnostné opatrenia.

Name: Screening (background checks)
Notes: Background checks required for employees and selected suppliers before they join the organisation.
EN Notes: Background checks required for employees and selected suppliers before they join the organisation.
SK Notes: Preverenie pozadia, bezúhonnosti a spoľahlivosti zamestnancov a vybraných dodávateľov pred ich prijatím do organizácie.

Name: Terms, conditions and quailification criteria of employment
Notes: Establishing a contractual agreement that informs new employees about their responsibilities and the company’s responsibilities regarding information security.
EN Name: Terms, conditions and quailification criteria of employment
EN Notes: Establishing a contractual agreement that informs new employees about their responsibilities and the company’s responsibilities regarding information security.
SK Name: Podmienky, zásady a kvalifikačné kritériá zamestnania
SK Notes: Vytvorenie zmluvnej dohody, ktorá informuje nových zamestnancov o ich zodpovednostiach a zodpovednostiach spoločnosti v oblasti informačnej bezpečnosti.

Name: Information security awareness, education and training and security awareness development plan
Notes: Ensuring awareness, education, and appropriate training in information security, including regular educational activities related to the organization's adopted policies.
EN Name: Information security awareness, education and training and security awareness development plan
EN Notes: Ensuring awareness, education, and appropriate training in information security, including regular educational activities related to the organization's adopted policies.
SK Name: Povedomie o informačnej bezpečnosti, vzdelávanie a školenie a plán rozvoja povedomia o bezpečnosti
SK Notes: Zabezpečenie povedomia, vzdelávania a príslušného školenia v oblasti informačnej bezpečnosti, vrátane pravidelných vzdelávacích aktivít týkajúcich sa politík prijatých organizáciou.

Name: Disciplinary process
Notes: The obligation to establish a formal disciplinary process for violations of the organization's information security policies.
EN Notes: The obligation to establish a formal disciplinary process for violations of the organization's information security policies.
SK Notes: Povinnosť zaviesť formálny disciplinárny proces pre porušenia politík informačnej bezpečnosti organizácie.

Name: Responsibilities After Termination or Change of Employment
Notes: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment are defined, communicated to the employee or contractor, and enforced. e.g. Checklist for employee / administrator  onboarding, employee / administrator transfer, and termination of employment / administrator are defined and maintained.
EN Name: Responsibilities After Termination or Change of Employment
EN Notes: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment are defined, communicated to the employee or contractor, and enforced, e.g. Checklist for employee / administrator  onboarding, employee / administrator transfer, and termination of employment / administrator are defined and maintained.
SK Name: Zodpovednosti po ukončení alebo zmene zamestnania
SK Notes: Zodpovednosti a povinnosti v oblasti informačnej bezpečnosti, ktoré zostávajú platné po ukončení alebo zmene pracovného pomeru, sú definované, komunikované zamestnancovi alebo dodávateľovi a vymáhané. Napr. kontrolný zoznam pre nástup zamestnanca/administrátora, presun zamestnanca/administrátora a ukončenie pracovného pomeru/administrátora sú definované a udržiavané.

Name: Acceptable use and handling of information assets
Notes: The obligation to have identified, documented, and implemented rules for the use and procedures for handling information and other assets.
EN Name: Acceptable use and handling of information assets
EN Notes: The obligation to have identified, documented, and implemented rules for the use and procedures for handling information and other assets.
SK Name: Prijateľné používanie a manipulácia s informačnými aktívami
SK Notes: Povinnosť mať identifikované, zdokumentované a implementované pravidlá pre používanie a spracovanie informácií a ďalších aktív.

Name: Return of information assets
Notes: The obligation to establish rules for employees and other interested parties to return all assets owned by the organization upon a change or termination of a contract. For example, including in the organization's policies the requirement for employees and contractors to return all information and assets belonging to the organization.
EN Notes: The obligation to establish rules for employees and other interested parties to return all assets owned by the organization upon a change or termination of a contract. For example, including in the organization's policies the requirement for employees and contractors to return all information and assets belonging to the organization.
SK Notes: Povinnosť stanoviť pravidlá pre zamestnancov a ďalšie zainteresované strany, aby v prípade zmeny alebo ukončenia zmluvy vrátili všetky aktíva patriace organizácii. Napríklad, že v politikách organizácie bude uvedená požiadavka, aby zamestnanci a dodávatelia vrátili všetky informácie a aktíva, ktoré patria organizácii.

Name: Classification of information
Notes: A preventive control that enables organizations to identify risks by determining the appropriate level of protection for each information asset based on its importance and sensitivity. For example, information intended for public consumption must be appropriately marked, while confidential or commercially sensitive data must be secured with a higher level of protection. The ultimate responsibility for the correct implementation of information classification lies with the asset owners.
EN Notes: A preventive control that enables organizations to identify risks by determining the appropriate level of protection for each information asset based on its importance and sensitivity. For example, information intended for public consumption must be appropriately marked, while confidential or commercially sensitive data must be secured with a higher level of protection. The ultimate responsibility for the correct implementation of information classification lies with the asset owners.
SK Notes: Preventívna kontrola, ktorá organizáciám umožňuje identifikovať riziká určením vhodnej úrovne ochrany pre každé informačné aktívum na základe jeho dôležitosti a citlivosti. Napríklad informácie určené na verejné zverejnenie musia byť primerane označené, zatiaľ čo dôverné alebo obchodne citlivé údaje musia byť chránené vyššou úrovňou ochrany. Konečná zodpovednosť za správnu implementáciu klasifikácie informácií spočíva na vlastníkoch aktív.

Name: Labelling of information
Notes: All data assets must be appropriately labelled, and asset owners are responsible for any changes in labelling, ensuring the consistent application of access and modification rights.
EN Notes: All data assets must be appropriately labelled, and asset owners are responsible for any changes in labelling, ensuring the consistent application of access and modification rights.
SK Notes: Všetky dátové aktíva musia byť správne označené a vlastníci aktív sú zodpovední za akékoľvek zmeny v označení, pričom zabezpečujú konzistentné uplatňovanie práv na prístup a úpravy.

Name: Management of removable media
Notes: Procedures are implemented for the management of removable media in accordance with the classification scheme adopted by the organization, including e.g. blocking USB and disabling auto-run of programs from removable media to prevent the automatic execution of malicious programs, etc.
EN Notes: Procedures are implemented for the management of removable media in accordance with the classification scheme adopted by the organization, including e.g. blocking USB and disabling auto-run of programs from removable media to prevent the automatic execution of malicious programs, etc.
SK Notes: Procedúry na správu prenosných médií sú implementované v súlade s klasifikačnou schémou prijatou organizáciou, vrátane blokovania USB portov a zakázania automatického spúšťania programov z prenosných médií, aby sa predišlo automatickému spusteniu škodlivých programov.

Name: Access control and policy
Notes: To manage access to assets within the scope of an organisation, an access control policy must be developed, documented, and periodically reviewed.
EN Notes: To manage access to assets within the scope of an organisation, an access control policy must be developed, documented, and periodically reviewed.
SK Name: Kontrola prístupu a politiky riadenia prístupu
SK Notes: Správa a riadenie prístupov k aktívam v rámci organizácie a vypracovanie, zdokumentovanie a pravidelne prehodnocovanie politiky prístupov.

Name: Identity Management
Notes: The organisation's obligation to identify who (users, groups of users) or what (applications, systems, and devices) is accessing data or IT assets at any given moment, and how access rights are assigned to these identities.
EN Notes: The organisation's obligation to identify who (users, groups of users) or what (applications, systems, and devices) is accessing data or IT assets at any given moment, and how access rights are assigned to these identities.
SK Notes: Povinnosť organizácie identifikovať, kto (užívatelia, skupiny užívateľov) alebo čo (aplikácie, systémy a zariadenia) pristupuje k údajom alebo IT aktívam v danom okamihu a akým spôsobom sú prístupové práva priradené týmto identitám.

Name: User access rights management and review
Notes: The organisation must implement procedures and controls for assigning, modifying, and revoking access rights to information systems in accordance with its access control policy. For example, if the access rights of a former employee are not revoked, they may steal sensitive data.
EN Name: User access rights management and review
EN Notes: The organisation must implement procedures and controls for assigning, modifying, and revoking access rights to information systems in accordance with its access control policy. For example, if the access rights of a former employee are not revoked, they may steal sensitive data.
SK Name: Správa a kontrola prístupových práv používateľov
SK Notes: Organizácia musí implementovať postupy a kontroly na priradenie, úpravu a zrušenie prístupových práv k informačným systémom v súlade so svojou politikou prístupu. Napríklad, ak prístupové práva bývalého zamestnanca nie sú zrušené, môže dôjsť k odcudzeniu citlivých údajov.

Name: Privileged access rights management and review
Notes: The organisation has an obligation to manage and monitor privileged domain or application user accounts. For example, this is due to the threat of ICT infrastructure disruption caused by the misuse of elevated system administrator privileges.
EN Name: Privileged access rights management and review
EN Notes: The organisation has an obligation to manage and monitor privileged domain or application user accounts. For example, this is due to the threat of ICT infrastructure disruption caused by the misuse of elevated system administrator privileges.
SK Name: Správa a kontrola prístupových práv privilegovaných používateľov
SK Notes: Organizácia má povinnosť spravovať a monitorovať privilegované účty používateľov domény alebo aplikácií. Toto je dôležité najmä kvôli hrozbe narušenia IKT infraštruktúry, ktorá môže vzniknúť napr. zneužitím neopodstatnene zvýšených práv systémového administrátora.

Name: Management and use of secret authentication information and other credentials
Notes: The allocation of secret authentication information is controlled through a formal management process, e.g. password policy is defined, security questions and other credentials are secured, password manager is used, etc.
EN Name: Management and use of secret authentication information and other credentials
EN Notes: The allocation of secret authentication information is controlled through a formal management process, e.g. password policy is defined, security questions and other credentials are secured, password manager is used, etc.
SK Name: Správa a používanie citlivých autentifikačných informácií a iných poverení
SK Notes: Formálne riadenie citlivých autentifikačných údajov a iných oprávnení, napr. formou definovania politiky hesiel, zabezpečenia bezpečnostných otázok a ďalších prihlasovacích údajov, používanie správcu hesiel a pod.

Name: Information access restriction
Notes: Access to information and other related assets must be restricted in accordance with the organisation's internal access control policy.
EN Notes: Access to information and other related assets must be restricted in accordance with the organisation's internal access control policy.
SK Notes: Prístup k informáciám a ďalším súvisiacim aktívam musí byť obmedzený v súlade s internou politikou riadenia prístupu organizácie.

Name: Secure Authentication and multi factor authentication
Notes: Secure authentication technologies and procedures are implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control. It focuses on protecting against unauthorized access using technologies and procedures such as biometric authentication, Two-Factor Authentication (2FA), One-Time Passwords (OTP), etc.
EN Name: Secure Authentication and multi factor authentication
EN Notes: Secure authentication technologies and procedures are implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control. It focuses on protecting against unauthorized access using technologies and procedures such as biometric authentication, Two-Factor Authentication (2FA), One-Time Passwords (OTP), etc.
SK Notes: Bezpečnostné autentifikačné technológie a postupy sú implementované na základe obmedzení prístupu k informáciám a špecifickej politiky riadenia prístupu. Tieto postupy sa zameriavajú na ochranu pred neoprávneným prístupom pomocou technológií ako biometrická autentifikácia, dvojfaktorová autentifikácia (2FA), jednorazové heslá (OTP) a podobne.

Name: Network access control (NAC, 802.1x)
Notes: Authentification of devices before granting them access to the network. The NAC solution ensures that only authorized and compliant devices are allowed to connect to the network, based on predefined security policies.
EN Notes: Authentification of devices before granting them access to the network. The NAC solution ensures that only authorized and compliant devices are allowed to connect to the network, based on predefined security policies.
SK Notes: Autentifikácia zariadení pred udelením prístupu do siete. Riešenie NAC zabezpečuje, že do siete sa pripoja iba autorizované a vyhovujúce zariadenia na základe vopred stanovených bezpečnostných politík.

Name: Restricted use of privileged utility programs
Notes: Establishing policies for the use of utility programs (such as backup servers, antivirus programs, and patching assistants) must be controlled.
EN Name: Restricted use of privileged utility programs
EN Notes: Establishing policies for the use of utility programs (such as backup servers, antivirus programs, and patching assistants) must be controlled.
SK Notes: Stanovenie politík pre používanie obslužných programov (ako sú napr. zálohovacie skripty, antivírusové programy a nástroje na asistenciu pri aktualizácii a pod.) musí byť riadené.

Name: Restricted access to program source code
Notes: Access to program source code must be strictly limited to authorized personnel based on their role and business requirements. This control ensures that only individuals with a legitimate need can view, modify, or deploy source code to reduce the risk of unauthorized changes, theft, or exposure of intellectual property. Key measures include: role-based access control, segregation of duties, regular audits etc.
EN Name: Restricted access to program source code
EN Notes: Access to program source code must be strictly limited to authorized personnel based on their role and business requirements. This control ensures that only individuals with a legitimate need can view, modify, or deploy source code to reduce the risk of unauthorized changes, theft, or exposure of intellectual property. Key measures include: role-based access control, segregation of duties, regular audits etc.
SK Name: Obmedzený prístup k zdrojovému kódu programu
SK Notes: Prístup k zdrojovému kódu programu musí byť prísne obmedzený na autorizovaných zamestnancov na základe ich úlohy a obchodných požiadaviek. Táto kontrola zabezpečuje, že kód môžu zobraziť, upravovať alebo nasadiť iba osoby, ktoré to skutočne potrebujú, čím sa minimalizuje riziko neoprávnených zmien, krádeže alebo úniku duševného vlastníctva. Kľúčové opatrenia zahŕňajú: riadenie prístupu na základe úlohy, oddelenie povinností, pravidelné audity a podobne.

Name: Policy on the use of cryptographic controls and key management
Notes: Policies for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, must be defined and implemented.
EN Name: Policy on the use of cryptographic controls and key management
EN Notes: Policies for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, must be defined and implemented.
SK Name: Politika používania kryptografických opatrení a správy kryptografických kľúčov
SK Notes: Politiky pre efektívne používanie kryptografie, vrátane správy kryptografických kľúčov, musia byť definované a implementované.

Name: Physical security perimeter
Notes: Security perimeters are defined and used to protect information and associated assets. These include any data or insights that have value to the organization.
EN Notes: Security perimeters are defined and used to protect information and associated assets. These include any data or insights that have value to the organization.
SK Notes: Sú zavedené bezpečnostné perimetre fyzickej ochrany ako napr. oplotenia, kamerové systémy, svetelné závory, vstupné koridory, nakladacie rampy a pod.

Name: Physical entry controls
Notes: Secure areas must be protected by appropriate entrances and access points as part of physical security. For example:  card-based access control, video surveillance access control etc.)
EN Notes: Secure areas must be protected by appropriate entrances and access points as part of physical security. For example:  card-based access control, video surveillance access control etc.)
SK Notes: Chránené oblasti musia byť zabezpečené vhodnými vstupmi a prístupovými bodmi ako súčasť fyzickej bezpečnosti. Napríklad: turnikety, špeciálne vstupné kabíny, prístupové systémy na báze kariet, video dohľad, kontrola prístupu a podobne.

Name: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
Notes: Secure areas must be protected by appropriate entrances and access points as part of physical security.
EN Notes: Secure areas must be protected by appropriate entrances and access points as part of physical security.
SK Name: Zabezpečenie kancelárií, miestností, zariadení a vybavenia
SK Notes: Chránené oblasti a priestory musia byť zabezpečené vhodnými mechanickými zábrannými prostriedkami (napr. mreže, zámky, steny, klietky, skrine, trezory a pod.).

Name: Physical security monitoring
Notes: Premises are continuously monitored for unathorized physical access by Security service (physical presence of security personnel). The organization employs trained security personnel to monitor, patrol, and protect its facilities. Security personnel are responsible for enforcing access control policies, responding to incidents, and ensuring compliance with organizational security standards.
EN Notes: Premises are continuously monitored for unathorized physical access by Security service (physical presence of security personnel). The organization employs trained security personnel to monitor, patrol, and protect its facilities. Security personnel are responsible for enforcing access control policies, responding to incidents, and ensuring compliance with organizational security standards.
SK Notes: Priestor je nepretržite monitorovaný na detekciu neoprávneného fyzického prístupu bezpečnostnou službou (prítomnosť bezpečnostného personálu), prípadne technickými zabezpečovacími prostriedkami (EZS, CCTV a pod.). Organizácia zamestnáva vyškolený bezpečnostný personál, ktorý monitoruje, vykonáva obchôdzky a chráni jej objekty. Bezpečnostný personál je zodpovedný za vynucovanie politík riadenia prístupu, reagovanie na incidenty a zabezpečenie dodržiavania bezpečnostných štandardov organizácie.

Name: Redundancy of communication networks and systems
Notes: Redundant communication lines and channels are established and maintained to ensure uninterrupted communication for critical operations. This includes diverse physical routes, backup technologies, and failover mechanisms to mitigate single points of failure. These backups are located in a securely separate area from the primary secured space.
EN Name: Redundancy of communication networks and systems
EN Notes: Redundant communication lines and channels are established and maintained to ensure uninterrupted communication for critical operations. This includes diverse physical routes, backup technologies, and failover mechanisms to mitigate single points of failure. These backups are located in a securely separate area from the primary secured space.
SK Notes: Sú zriadené a udržiavané záložné komunikačné linky a kanály, ktoré zabezpečujú nepretržitú komunikáciu pre kritické operácie. To zahŕňa rôzne fyzické trasy, záložné technológie a systémy na prechod v prípade výpadku, aby sa predišlo problémom v prípade zlyhania. Tieto zálohy sú umiestnené v bezpečne oddelenej oblasti od hlavného zabezpečeného priestoru.

Name: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
Notes: The organization's measure to carry out a comprehensive risk assessment before carrying out any operations in the physical premises and to implement appropriate measures proportionate to the identified risk. Such threats can include environmental damage, theft, destruction and compromise of data. All of these issues can lead to information loss and the potential exposure of sensitive data.
EN Name: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
EN Notes: The organization's measure to carry out a comprehensive risk assessment before carrying out any operations in the physical premises and to implement appropriate measures proportionate to the identified risk. Such threats can include environmental damage, theft, destruction and compromise of data. All of these issues can lead to information loss and the potential exposure of sensitive data.
SK Name: Ochrana pred fyzickými a environmentálnymi hrozbami
SK Notes: Organizácia vykoná kompletné hodnotenie rizika pred začatím akýchkoľvek činností v priestoroch a príjme opatrenia primerané zistenému riziku. Hrozby môžu zahŕňať environmentálne škody, krádeže, ničenie alebo ohrozenie údajov. Tieto problémy môžu viesť k strate informácií a vystaveniu citlivých údajov. Prijímajú sa adekvátne opatrenia umiestnenia technických miestností, zabezpečenia klimatických podmienok, monitorovania stavu a pod.

Name: Working in secure areas
Notes: Implementation of security rules of the organization in order to protect its information assets located in secured areas from various risks.
EN Notes: Implementation of security rules of the organization in order to protect its information assets located in secured areas from various risks.
SK Notes: Implementácia bezpečnostných pravidiel organizácie na ochranu jej informačných aktív umiestnených v zabezpečených oblastiach pred rôznymi rizikami, napr. politika čistého stola, povinnosť uzamykania priestorov pri odchode, vstupný systém, zatemnenie okien a pod.

Name: Equipment siting and protection
Notes: The organization must implement measures to protect IT equipment containing information assets from physical and environmental threats. Organizations must ensure that equipment is stored in secure areas, regularly monitor environmental conditions (temperature, humidity), and prevent unauthorized access, damage, or destruction of equipment. This also includes maintaining an inventory of equipment and adopting preventive measures against power outages, theft, and interference.
EN Notes: The organization must implement measures to protect IT equipment containing information assets from physical and environmental threats. Organizations must ensure that equipment is stored in secure areas, regularly monitor environmental conditions (temperature, humidity), and prevent unauthorized access, damage, or destruction of equipment. This also includes maintaining an inventory of equipment and adopting preventive measures against power outages, theft, and interference.
SK Notes: Organizácia musí implementovať opatrenia na ochranu IT zariadení obsahujúcich informačné aktíva pred fyzickými a environmentálnymi hrozbami. Organizácie musia zabezpečiť, aby zariadenia boli uložené v bezpečných oblastiach, pravidelne monitorovať environmentálne podmienky (teplota, vlhkosť) a zabrániť neoprávnenému prístupu, poškodeniu alebo zničeniu zariadení. To zahŕňa aj udržiavanie inventára zariadení a prijímanie preventívnych opatrení proti výpadkom elektrickej energie, krádežiam a narušeniam.

Name: Supporting utilities security and controls
Notes: Organizations must protect supporting utilities, such as electricity, gas, water, and cooling, from failures or disruptions to ensure the availability and integrity of information assets and business continuity. Organizations must identify risks, implement appropriate controls, and ensure the continuous operation of these utilities.
EN Notes: Organizations must protect supporting utilities, such as electricity, gas, water, and cooling, from failures or disruptions to ensure the availability and integrity of information assets and business continuity. Organizations must identify risks, implement appropriate controls, and ensure the continuous operation of these utilities.
SK Name: Opatrenia a bezpečnosť zariadení a podporného vybavenia
SK Notes: Organizácie musia chrániť podporujúce inžinierske siete, ako sú elektrina, plyn, voda a chladenie, pred zlyhaniami alebo narušeniami, aby zabezpečili dostupnosť a integritu informačných aktív a kontinuitu podnikania. Organizácie musia identifikovať riziká, implementovať vhodné kontroly a zabezpečiť nepretržitú prevádzku týchto sietí.

Name: Cabling security
Notes: Organizations must protect information assets transmitted through cables, such as fibre, network, and power cables, from unauthorized access, damage, or destruction. This also includes implementing protective measures to ensure security and business continuity by preventing risks such as interception, interference, or physical damage to cables. Compliance involves maintaining an inventory of cables, conducting risk assessments, and applying appropriate security measures.
EN Notes: Organizations must protect information assets transmitted through cables, such as fibre, network, and power cables, from unauthorized access, damage, or destruction. This also includes implementing protective measures to ensure security and business continuity by preventing risks such as interception, interference, or physical damage to cables. Compliance involves maintaining an inventory of cables, conducting risk assessments, and applying appropriate security measures.
SK Notes: Organizácie musia chrániť káble, cez ktoré sa prenášajú informačné aktíva, ako optické vlákna, sieťové a napájacie káble, pred neoprávneným prístupom, poškodením alebo zničením. To zahŕňa opatrenia na ochranu pred rizikami, ako je napr. odpočúvanie, narušenia alebo fyzické poškodenie káblov, aby sa zabezpečila bezpečnosť a kontinuita činností. Organizácie musia mať inventár káblov, hodnotiť riziká a prijať potrebné bezpečnostné opatrenia.

Name: Equipment maintenance
Notes: Organizations must implement procedures and measures for the proper maintenance of equipment to ensure the security and integrity of information assets stored on these devices. Regular maintenance of IT equipment, such as servers and laptops, is essential to prevent performance degradation, loss, or unauthorized access to information assets due to environmental factors or failure to follow manufacturer specifications.
EN Notes: Organizations must implement procedures and measures for the proper maintenance of equipment to ensure the security and integrity of information assets stored on these devices. Regular maintenance of IT equipment, such as servers and laptops, is essential to prevent performance degradation, loss, or unauthorized access to information assets due to environmental factors or failure to follow manufacturer specifications.
SK Notes: Organizácie musia implementovať postupy a opatrenia na správnu údržbu zariadení, aby zabezpečili bezpečnosť a integritu informačných aktív uložených na týchto zariadeniach. Pravidelná údržba IT zariadení, ako sú servery a prenosné počítače, je kľúčová na prevenciu zhoršenia výkonu, straty alebo neoprávneného prístupu k informačným aktívam z dôvodu environmentálnych faktorov alebo nedodržania špecifikácií výrobcu.

Name: Storage media security
Notes: Policies and controls to ensure the security of storage media devices throughout their entire life cycle, from acquisition to disposal, are implemented. It mandates measures to mitigate risks related to unauthorized access, usage, deletion, alteration, and transmission of sensitive data on storage media, covering both physical and digital media such as SSDs, USB drives, and hard disks.
EN Notes: Policies and controls to ensure the security of storage media devices throughout their entire life cycle, from acquisition to disposal, are implemented. It mandates measures to mitigate risks related to unauthorized access, usage, deletion, alteration, and transmission of sensitive data on storage media, covering both physical and digital media such as SSDs, USB drives, and hard disks.
SK Notes: Organizácie implementujú politiky a kontrolné opatrenia na zabezpečenie bezpečnosti úložných zariadení počas celého ich životného cyklu, od akvizície až po likvidáciu. Stanovujú opatrenia na zmiernenie rizík spojených s neoprávneným prístupom, používaním, vymazávaním, zmenou a prenosom citlivých údajov na úložných zariadeniach, ktoré zahŕňajú ako fyzické, tak aj digitálne médiá, ako sú napr. pevné disky, SSD, USB disky a pod.

Name: Security of equipment and assets off-premises
Notes: Implemented controls and procedures to ensure the security of devices containing valuable information assets when they are off-site. These measures aim to protect off-site devices from risks such as loss, theft, damage, or unauthorized access, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data and preventing disruptions to business operations.
EN Name: Security of equipment and assets off-premises
EN Notes: Implemented controls and procedures to ensure the security of devices containing valuable information assets when they are off-site. These measures aim to protect off-site devices from risks such as loss, theft, damage, or unauthorized access, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data and preventing disruptions to business operations.
SK Name: Bezpečnosť zariadení a majetku mimo priestorov organizácie
SK Notes: Implementované kontrolné opatrenia a postupy na zabezpečenie zariadení obsahujúcich cenné informačné aktíva, keď sú mimo areálu. Tieto opatrenia majú za cieľ chrániť zariadenia mimo areálu pred rizikami, ako sú strata, krádež, poškodenie alebo neoprávnený prístup, a zabezpečiť dôvernosť, integritu a dostupnosť dát.

Name: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
Notes: All information and licensed software will be permanently erased or overwritten from devices before their disposal, reuse, or transfer to a third party. This measure helps prevent unauthorized access to sensitive data and ensures the confidentiality of information stored on outdated IT devices such as laptops, printers, and external drives.
EN Name: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
EN Notes: All information and licensed software will be permanently erased or overwritten from devices before their disposal, reuse, or transfer to a third party. This measure helps prevent unauthorized access to sensitive data and ensures the confidentiality of information stored on outdated IT devices such as laptops, printers, and external drives.
SK Name: Bezpečná likvidácia alebo opätovné použitie zariadení
SK Notes: Všetky informácie a licencovaný softvér budú pred likvidáciou, opätovným použitím alebo odovzdaním tretej strane natrvalo vymazané alebo prepísané zo zariadení. Toto opatrenie pomáha zabrániť neoprávnenému prístupu k citlivým údajom a zabezpečuje dôvernosť informácií uložených na zastaraných IT zariadeniach, ako sú prenosné počítače, tlačiarne a externé disky.

Name: Clear desk and clear screen policy
Notes: The implementation of a clear desk and clear screen policy to protect sensitive information on digital screens and physical documents when workstations are unattended. These measures help mitigate risks such as unauthorized access, misuse, or loss of confidential information by ensuring proper handling and protection of materials in the workplace.
EN Name: Clear desk and clear screen policy
EN Notes: The implementation of a clear desk and clear screen policy to protect sensitive information on digital screens and physical documents when workstations are unattended. These measures help mitigate risks such as unauthorized access, misuse, or loss of confidential information by ensuring proper handling and protection of materials in the workplace.
SK Name: Politika čistého stola a prázdnej obrazovky
SK Notes: Zavedenie politiky čistého stola a čistej obrazovky na ochranu citlivých informácií na obrazovkách a dokumentoch, keď nie je prítomný zamestnanec. Tieto opatrenia pomáhajú zabrániť neoprávnenému prístupu, zneužitiu alebo strate dôverných informácií tým, že zabezpečujú správnu ochranu materiálov na pracovisku.

Name: Documented operating procedures
Notes: Operational procedures for maintaining information security are managed and performed by individuals within the organisation. These procedures ensure the efficiency and security of information security operations.
EN Notes: Operational procedures for maintaining information security are managed and performed by individuals within the organisation. These procedures ensure the efficiency and security of information security operations.
SK Notes: Definované prevádzkové postupy na zabezpečenie informačnej bezpečnosti. Tieto postupy zabezpečujú efektívnosť,  bezpečnosť a jednotný postup pri vykonávaní jednotlivých prevádzkových činností.

Name: Capacity management
Notes: Ensuring sufficient ICT capacity to meet user demands and effectively manage infrastructure, including data centers and networks, to support business needs. This control combines preventive and detective measures to maintain optimal capacity and minimize risks that could affect the integrity and functionality of business operations.
EN Notes: Ensuring sufficient ICT capacity to meet user demands and effectively manage infrastructure, including data centers and networks, to support business needs. This control combines preventive and detective measures to maintain optimal capacity and minimize risks that could affect the integrity and functionality of business operations.
SK Notes: Zabezpečenie dostatočnej IKT kapacity na splnenie požiadaviek používateľov a správu infraštruktúry, ako sú dátové centrá a siete, na podporu obchodných potrieb. Toto opatrenie pomáha udržiavať optimálnu kapacitu a znižovať riziká, ktoré by mohli ovplyvniť fungovanie organizácie.

Name: Four-eyes principle (principle of dual control)
Notes: The four-eyes principle (dual control) is implemented across critical business processes, systems, and operations, requiring at least two individuals to review, authorize, or perform sensitive tasks, ensuring accountability, integrity, and security.
EN Notes: The four-eyes principle (dual control) is implemented across critical business processes, systems, and operations, requiring at least two individuals to review, authorize, or perform sensitive tasks, ensuring accountability, integrity, and security.
SK Notes: Princíp štyroch očí (duálna kontrola) je implementovaný v kritických procesoch, systémoch a operáciách, čo vyžaduje, aby aspoň dvaja ľudia preverili, schválili alebo vykonali citlivé úlohy, čím sa zabezpečuje zodpovednosť, integrita a bezpečnosť.

Name: Separation of development, testing and operational environments
Notes: Ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information by implementing appropriate processes, controls, and regulations to separate the development, testing, and production environments.
EN Name: Separation of development, testing and operational environments
EN Notes: Ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information by implementing appropriate processes, controls, and regulations to separate the development, testing, and production environments.
SK Name: Oddelenie vývojového, testovacieho a prevádzkového prostredia
SK Notes: Zabezpečenie dôvernosti, integrity a dostupnosti informácií implementovaním vhodných procesov, kontrol a predpisov na oddelenie vývojového, testovacieho a produkčného prostredia.

Name: Controls against malware
Notes: Implementing measures to protect against malware and educating employees to mitigate risks associated with malware, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets. For example, an organization can implement antivirus protection, ransomware protection, email filtering tools and regularly train employees to recognize phishing attempts and prevent malware infections.
EN Notes: Implementing measures to protect against malware and educating employees to mitigate risks associated with malware, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets. For example, an organization can implement antivirus protection, ransomware protection, email filtering tools and regularly train employees to recognize phishing attempts and prevent malware infections.
SK Notes: Zavedenie opatrení na ochranu pred malvérom a vzdelávanie zamestnancov na zmiernenie rizík spojených s malvérom, čím sa zabezpečuje dôvernosť, integrita a dostupnosť informačných aktív. Napríklad organizácia môže implementovať antivírusovú ochranu, ochranu proti ransomvéru, nástroje na filtrovanie e-mailov a pravidelne školí zamestnancov, aby rozpoznali pokusy o phishing a zabránili infekciám malvérom.

Name: Configuration management, configuration management database (CMDB)
Notes: Configuration management ensures the proper functioning and security of hardware, software, and networks by managing and protecting configuration files from unauthorized changes.
EN Notes: Configuration management ensures the proper functioning and security of hardware, software, and networks by managing and protecting configuration files from unauthorized changes.
SK Notes: Správa konfigurácie zabezpečuje správne fungovanie a bezpečnosť hardvéru, softvéru a sietí tým, že spravuje a chráni konfiguračné súbory pred neoprávnenými zmenami.

Name: System hardening (hardening compliance)
Notes: Collection of tools, techniques, and best practices to reduce vulnerability in technology applications, systems, infrastructure, firmware, and other areas (e.g. remove unnecessary files, libraries, drivers, default passwords, components and functionalities, configure and limit file system and registry permissions, enforce security policies, enable BPDU guards and DHCP snooping, block unused ports, etc.).  System hardening activities include: Application hardening, Operating system hardening, Server hardening, Endpoint hardening, Database hardening, Network hardening.
EN Notes: Collection of tools, techniques, and best practices to reduce vulnerability in technology applications, systems, infrastructure, firmware, and other areas (e.g. remove unnecessary files, libraries, drivers, default passwords, components and functionalities, configure and limit file system and registry permissions, enforce security policies, enable BPDU guards and DHCP snooping, block unused ports, etc.).  System hardening activities include: Application hardening, Operating system hardening, Server hardening, Endpoint hardening, Database hardening, Network hardening.
SK Notes: Súbor nástrojov, techník a osvedčených postupov na zníženie zraniteľností v technológiach, aplikáciách, systémoch, infraštruktúre, firmvéri a ďalších oblastiach (napríklad odstránenie nepotrebných súborov, knižníc, ovládačov, predvolených hesiel, komponentov a funkcií, nastavenie a obmedzenie práv k súborovému systému a registre, vynucovanie bezpečnostných politík, aktivovanie BPDU guards a DHCP snooping, blokovanie nepoužívaných portov atď.). Aktivity zabezpečenia systému zahŕňajú: Hardening aplikácií, hardening operačného systému, hardening serverov, hardening koncových zariadení, hardening databáz, hardening sietí.

Name: Information deletion - physical disposal (e.g. shredder, drill, hammer, degaussing, HDD/CD/DVD shredder)
Notes: A measure to erase data when it is no longer needed, reducing the risk of unintended disclosure or unauthorized access. Organizations should ensure the use of appropriate deletion methods (e.g. shredders), compliance with legal requirements, and proper documentation of the deletion process.
EN Name: Information deletion - physical disposal (e.g. shredder, drill, hammer, degaussing, HDD/CD/DVD shredder)
EN Notes: A measure to erase data when it is no longer needed, reducing the risk of unintended disclosure or unauthorized access. Organizations should ensure the use of appropriate deletion methods (e.g. shredders), compliance with legal requirements, and proper documentation of the deletion process.
SK Name: Vymazanie informácií – fyzická likvidácia (napr. drvič, vŕtačka, kladivo, demagnetizácia, skartovačka HDD/CD/DVD)
SK Notes: Opatrenie na vymazanie dát, keď už nie sú potrebné, čím sa znižuje riziko neúmyselného zverejnenia alebo neoprávneného prístupu. Organizácie by mali zabezpečiť používanie vhodných metód vymazania (napr. skartovačky), dodržiavanie právnych požiadaviek a riadne zdokumentovanie procesu vymazania.

Name: Information deletion - secure electronic information disposal (e.g. software shredder)
Notes: Ensuring the secure deletion of electronic information using appropriate disposal methods, such as software shredders, to make data unrecoverable. This measure minimizes the risk of unauthorized access or data recovery by ensuring the permanent removal of sensitive information in compliance with organizational policies and legal requirements.
EN Name: Information deletion - secure electronic information disposal (e.g. software shredder)
EN Notes: Ensuring the secure deletion of electronic information using appropriate disposal methods, such as software shredders, to make data unrecoverable. This measure minimizes the risk of unauthorized access or data recovery by ensuring the permanent removal of sensitive information in compliance with organizational policies and legal requirements.
SK Name: Vymazanie informácií – bezpečná elektronická likvidácia informácií (napr. softvérový skartovač)
SK Notes: Zabezpečenie bezpečného vymazania elektronických informácií pomocou vhodných metód likvidácie, ako sú softvérové skartovačky, aby sa dáta stali neobnoviteľnými. Toto opatrenie minimalizuje riziko neoprávneného prístupu alebo obnovenia dát tým, že zabezpečuje trvalé odstránenie citlivých informácií v súlade s politikami organizácie a právnymi požiadavkami.

Name: Data masking (e.g. anonymization and tokenization)
Notes: Data masking is used in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies, and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration. Data anonymization and tokenization are implemented to safeguard sensitive information by replacing it with irreversible or reversible substitutes, ensuring privacy and security without compromising data usability where required.
EN Notes: Data masking is used in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies, and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration. Data anonymization and tokenization are implemented to safeguard sensitive information by replacing it with irreversible or reversible substitutes, ensuring privacy and security without compromising data usability where required.
SK Notes: Maskovanie dát sa vykonáva podľa politiky organizácie týkajúcej sa prístupu k dátam a ďalších relevantných pravidiel, pričom sa berú do úvahy aj zákony. Anonymizácia a tokenizácia dát sa používajú na ochranu citlivých informácií tým, že ich nahradia inými hodnotami, ktoré sa nedajú obnoviť (alebo dajú len pri znalosti napr. tajného šiforvacieho kľúča) a tým zabezpečia ochranu súkromia a bezpečnosti, pričom údaje môžu byť stále použiteľné, keď je to potrebné.

Name: Data leakage prevention, Data loss prevention system (DLP)
Notes: Measures to prevent unauthorized access, transmission, or extraction of information by internal and external personnel, systems, or malicious entities. The DLP system is deployed to identify, monitor, and protect sensitive data at rest, in transit, and in use. The DLP system enforces policies to prevent unauthorized data transfers, ensures compliance with legal and regulatory standards, and mitigates the risks of data leakage.
EN Name: Data leakage prevention, Data loss prevention system (DLP)
EN Notes: Measures to prevent unauthorized access, transmission, or extraction of information by internal and external personnel, systems, or malicious entities. The DLP system is deployed to identify, monitor, and protect sensitive data at rest, in transit, and in use. The DLP system enforces policies to prevent unauthorized data transfers, ensures compliance with legal and regulatory standards, and mitigates the risks of data leakage.
SK Name: Prevencia úniku údajov, Systém prevencie straty údajov (DLP)
SK Notes: Opatrenia na zabránenie neoprávnenému prístupu alebo prenosu citlivých informácií. Systém DLP (prevencia úniku dát) sa používa na ochranu dát, keď sú uložené, prenášané alebo používané. Tento systém zabraňuje neautorizovanému prenosu dát, zabezpečuje dodržiavanie právnych predpisov a pomáha predchádzať úniku informácií.

Name: Information backup
Notes: Ensuring risk management by implementing policies that enable timely recovery from data loss or system outages. The organization’s backup operations should include a robust and controlled process with appropriate data retention levels and agreed-upon recovery times, taking into account the types of data and risk levels. 3-2-1 principle should be used.
EN Notes: Ensuring risk management by implementing policies that enable timely recovery from data loss or system outages. The organization’s backup operations should include a robust and controlled process with appropriate data retention levels and agreed-upon recovery times, taking into account the types of data and risk levels. 3-2-1 principle should be used.
SK Notes: Zabezpečenie riadenia rizík implementovaním politík, ktoré umožnia včasnú obnovu po strate dát alebo výpadkoch systémov. Sú definované procesy zálohovania a obnovy, doba uloženia záloh, počet redundantných kópii záloh (princíp 3-2-1) a taktiež časy obnovy, pričom sa zohľadňuje klasifikácia a dostupnosť dát a úrovne rizika.

Name: Event logging and secure log management
Notes: Logs should be regularly reviewed, protected from unauthorized access, and maintained in accordance with the organization's policies, e.g. central Log Management system (LMS) can be used.
EN Name: Event logging and secure log management
EN Notes: Logs should be regularly reviewed, protected from unauthorized access, and maintained in accordance with the organization's policies, e.g. central Log Management system (LMS) can be used.
SK Name: Zaznamenávanie udalostí a bezpečné spravovanie auditných a log záznamov
SK Notes: Záznamy by mali byť pravidelne kontrolované, chránené pred neoprávneným prístupom a uchovávané v súlade s politikami organizácie, napríklad môže byť použitý centrálny systém pre uloženie a správu logov a auditných záznamov (LMS).

Name: Clock synchronisation
Notes: Ensuring accurate and reliable synchronization of the organization's information system clocks, thereby supporting effective incident monitoring and investigations.
EN Notes: Ensuring accurate and reliable synchronization of the organization's information system clocks, thereby supporting effective incident monitoring and investigations.
SK Notes: Zabezpečenie správnej a spoľahlivej synchronizácie systémových hodín v informačných systémoch organizácie voči jednému referenčnému a spoľahlivému zdroju času, čo pomáha pri monitorovaní a vyšetrovaní incidentov.

Name: Security monitoring (Monitoring activities)
Notes: Ensuring network monitoring, system monitoring, application monitoring and management of IT operations with system administrator access, thereby supporting incident prevention and effective response. For example Security Information and Event Management (SIEM).
EN Notes: Ensuring network monitoring, system monitoring, application monitoring and management of IT operations with system administrator access, thereby supporting incident prevention and effective response. For example Security Information and Event Management (SIEM).
SK Notes: Zabezpečenie monitorovania siete, systémov a aplikácií a správy IT operácií s prístupom pre administrátorov systémov, čím sa podporuje prevencia incidentov a efektívna reakcia. Príkladom je systém na správu bezpečnostných informácií a udalostí (SIEM).

Name: Intrusion detection system (IDS) and intrusion prevention system (IPS)
Notes: Setting network and communication security according to the environment by implementing an intrusion detection system (IDS) or intrusion prevention system (IPS) to identify unusual attack patterns or proactively block malicious network traffic.
EN Name: Intrusion detection system (IDS) and intrusion prevention system (IPS)
EN Notes: Setting network and communication security according to the environment by implementing an intrusion detection system (IDS) or intrusion prevention system (IPS) to identify unusual attack patterns or proactively block malicious network traffic.
SK Name: Systém detekcie vniknutia (IDS) a systém prevencie vniknutia (IPS)
SK Notes: Nastavenie bezpečnosti siete a komunikácie podľa prostredia implementovaním systému IDS (intrusion detection system) alebo systému IPS (intrusion prevention system), ktorý identifikuje nezvyčajné vzory útokov alebo proaktívne blokuje škodlivý sieťový prenos.

Name: Installation of software on operational systems procedures
Notes: Ensuring the formal management and maintenance of operational software and computer systems in accordance with strict regulations to minimize risks and ensure the efficiency and security of internal and external networks.
EN Name: Installation of software on operational systems procedures
EN Notes: Ensuring the formal management and maintenance of operational software and computer systems in accordance with strict regulations to minimize risks and ensure the efficiency and security of internal and external networks.
SK Notes: Definované formálne postupy pre zabezpečenie riadenia, inštalácie a údržby softvéru.

Name: Device installation in networks and information systems procedures
Notes: Ensuring the security management of network and information system operations through designated rules, responsibilities, and procedures for device installation in networks and information systems.
EN Name: Device installation in networks and information systems procedures
EN Notes: Ensuring the security management of network and information system operations through designated rules, responsibilities, and procedures for device installation in networks and information systems.
SK Name: Definované postupy inštalácie zariadení v sieťach a informačných systémoch
SK Notes: Definované formálne postupy pre zabezpečenie riadenia bezpečnosti prevádzky sietí a informačných systémov prostredníctvom určených pravidiel, zodpovedností a postupov pre inštaláciu zariadení v sieťach a informačných systémoch.

Name: Management of technical vulnerabilities
Notes: Ensuring the management and protection of the organization's software, systems, and ICT assets, thereby reducing the risk of exploitation of vulnerabilities and improving network security. Information about the technical vulnerabilities of used information systems is obtained, evaluating the organization's exposure to these vulnerabilities and taking appropriate measures.
EN Notes: Ensuring the management and protection of the organization's software, systems, and ICT assets, thereby reducing the risk of exploitation of vulnerabilities and improving network security. Information about the technical vulnerabilities of used information systems is obtained, evaluating the organization's exposure to these vulnerabilities and taking appropriate measures.
SK Notes: Zabezpečenie riadenia a ochrany softvéru, systémov a IT majetku organizácie, čím sa znižuje riziko zneužitia zraniteľností a zlepšuje bezpečnosť siete. Informácie o technických zraniteľnostiach používaných informačných systémov sa získavajú a vyhodnocuje sa vystavenie organizácie týmto zraniteľnostiam a následne sa prijímajú vhodné opatrenia.

Name: Application of public and vendor-provided lists for identifying vulnerabilities in IT assets
Notes: Identification of technical vulnerabilities in information systems as a whole through the use of public lists and vendor-provided lists that describe vulnerabilities in software and technical resources.
EN Name: Application of public and vendor-provided lists for identifying vulnerabilities in IT assets
EN Notes: Identification of technical vulnerabilities in information systems as a whole through the use of public lists and vendor-provided lists that describe vulnerabilities in software and technical resources.
SK Name: Použitie verejných a poskytovateľmi dodávaných zoznamov na identifikáciu zraniteľností informačných aktív
SK Notes: Identifikácia technických zraniteľností v informačných systémoch ako celku pomocou verejných zoznamov a zoznamov poskytovaných dodávateľmi, ktoré popisujú zraniteľnosti v softvéri a technických prostriedkoch.

Name: Vulnerability scaner (tool)
Notes: Identification of technical vulnerabilities in information systems as a whole through a tool designed to detect existing vulnerabilities in technical resources and their components.
EN Notes: Identification of technical vulnerabilities in information systems as a whole through a tool designed to detect existing vulnerabilities in technical resources and their components.
SK Notes: Identifikácia technických zraniteľností v informačných systémoch ako celku pomocou nástroja navrhnutého na detekciu existujúcich zraniteľností v technických prostriedkoch a ich komponentoch.

Name: Controls during audit testing of IS
Notes: Audit tests and assurance activities involving the assessment of operational systems are planned and agreed upon between the tester and the appropriate management.
EN Name: Controls during audit testing of IS
EN Notes: Audit tests and assurance activities involving the assessment of operational systems are planned and agreed upon between the tester and the appropriate management.
SK Notes: Auditné testy a overovacie činnosti, ktoré sa týkajú hodnotenia systémov a ich prevádzky, sa plánujú, analyzujú, prípadne testujú a vopred odsúhlasia medzi testerom (audítorom) a manažmentom organizácie zodpovedným za riadenie IB.

Name: Network Controls
Notes: Network security must be managed with care and precision to ensure the safety of all data. Ensuring that network activity is logged, compartmentalized, and performed by authorized personnel. Examples include: Firewall configuration, Virtual Private Network (VPN), Network Segmentation, Netflow monitoring, etc.
EN Notes: Network security must be managed with care and precision to ensure the safety of all data. Ensuring that network activity is logged, compartmentalized, and performed by authorized personnel. Examples include: Firewall configuration, Virtual Private Network (VPN), Network Segmentation, Netflow monitoring, etc.
SK Notes: Sieťová bezpečnosť musí byť riadne spravovaná, aby bola zabezpečená ochrana všetkých dát. To znamená, že všetky sieťové aktivity by mali byť zaznamenávané, správne rozdelené a riadené len oprávnenými osobami. Medzi príklady, ako to dosiahnuť, patrí nastavenie firewallu, použitie virtuálnej privátnej siete (VPN), segmentácia siete, alebo monitorovanie sieťovej prevádzky (Netflow).

Name: Security of network services
Notes: The implementation of technical concepts related to the maintenance and control of significant parts of an organization's ICT network. Network services such as email and security solutions (firewalls, antivirus platforms) are crucial for a modern commercial ICT network, requiring careful monitoring and management to reduce the risk of intrusion, failure, and disruption. Key measures: Firewall configuration, e-mail security, intrusion detection systems, access control systems, SLAs, etc.
EN Notes: The implementation of technical concepts related to the maintenance and control of significant parts of an organization's ICT network. Network services such as email and security solutions (firewalls, antivirus platforms) are crucial for a modern commercial ICT network, requiring careful monitoring and management to reduce the risk of intrusion, failure, and disruption. Key measures: Firewall configuration, e-mail security, intrusion detection systems, access control systems, SLAs, etc.
SK Notes: Implementácia technických riešení na správu a údržbu dôležitých častí ICT siete organizácie. Sieťové služby, ako napríklad e-mail a bezpečnostné nástroje (ako firewally a antivírusové programy), sú nevyhnutné pre každú modernú komerčnú sieť a potrebujú starostlivé sledovanie a správu, aby sa minimalizovali riziká spojené s narušením, zlyhaním alebo výpadkami. Dôležité opatrenia zahŕňajú správne nastavenie firewallu, ochranu e-mailov, systémy na detekciu narušení, systémy na riadenie prístupu, SLA a podobne.

Name: DNS security
Notes: Practice and measures of protecting DNS infrastructure from cyber attacks (DNS spoofing/cache poisoning, DNS tunneling, DNS hijacking, DoS (Denial of Service), NXDOMAIN attack, etc.) in order to keep it performing quickly and reliably. An effective DNS security strategy incorporates a number of overlapping defenses, including establishing redundant DNS servers, applying security protocols like DNSSEC, and requiring rigorous DNS logging.
EN Notes: Practice and measures of protecting DNS infrastructure from cyber attacks (DNS spoofing/cache poisoning, DNS tunneling, DNS hijacking, DoS (Denial of Service), NXDOMAIN attack, etc.) in order to keep it performing quickly and reliably. An effective DNS security strategy incorporates a number of overlapping defenses, including establishing redundant DNS servers, applying security protocols like DNSSEC, and requiring rigorous DNS logging.
SK Notes: Praktiky a opatrenia na ochranu DNS infraštruktúry pred kybernetickými útokmi (ako DNS spoofing/cache poisoning, DNS tunneling, DNS hijacking, DoS (Denial of Service), NXDOMAIN útoky a pod.) s cieľom zabezpečiť jej rýchlu a spoľahlivú prevádzku. Efektívna stratégia zabezpečenia DNS zahŕňa viacero vrstiev obrany, vrátane zavedenia redundantných DNS serverov, použitia bezpečnostných protokolov, ako je DNSSEC, a vyžadovania dôkladného DNS logovania.

Name: Firewall
Notes: Network and communication security is ensured primarily by allowing connections between network segments protected by a firewall based on the principle of least privilege, routing connections to external networks through a network firewall or using automation tools to identify unauthorized network connections at the boundary with the external network.
EN Notes: Network and communication security is ensured primarily by allowing connections between network segments protected by a firewall based on the principle of least privilege, routing connections to external networks through a network firewall or using automation tools to identify unauthorized network connections at the boundary with the external network.
SK Notes: Sieťová a komunikačná bezpečnosť sa zabezpečuje predovšetkým povolením pripojení medzi segmentmi siete, ktoré sú chránené firewallom podľa princípu minimálnych privilégií. Spojenia do externých sietí sa smerujú cez sieťový firewall, pričom sa využívajú aj automatizované nástroje na identifikáciu neoprávnených sieťových pripojení na hranici s externou sieťou.

Name: Maintaining a list of input/output points in network
Notes: Setting network and communication security by maintaining an up-to-date list of input and output points at the network boundary and maintaining an up-to-date whole network infrastructure documentation.
EN Name: Maintaining a list of input/output points in network
EN Notes: Setting network and communication security by maintaining an up-to-date list of input and output points at the network boundary and maintaining an up-to-date whole network infrastructure documentation.
SK Name: Udržiavanie zoznamu vstupných/výstupných bodov v sieti
SK Notes: Nastavenie sieťovej a komunikačnej bezpečnosti udržiavaním aktuálneho zoznamu vstupných a výstupných bodov na hranici siete a udržiavaním aktuálnej dokumentácie celej sieťovej infraštruktúry.

Name: Segregation in networks
Notes: Ensuring network segmentation into sub-networks based on the sensitivity and importance of information, limiting data transfer between different sub-networks, and reducing the risk of malware and virus infiltration.
EN Notes: Ensuring network segmentation into sub-networks based on the sensitivity and importance of information, limiting data transfer between different sub-networks, and reducing the risk of malware and virus infiltration.
SK Notes: Zabezpečenie segmentácie siete na podsiete podľa citlivosti a dôležitosti informácií, obmedzenie prenosu dát medzi rôznymi podsieťami a zníženie rizika infiltrácie malvéru a vírusov.

Name: Web filtering
Notes: Implementation of appropriate web access filters to restrict and control access to external websites and prevent security threats such as malware infection from accessing external websites with malicious content.
EN Notes: Implementation of appropriate web access filters to restrict and control access to external websites and prevent security threats such as malware infection from accessing external websites with malicious content.
SK Notes: Implementovanie filtrov prístupu na web, ktoré obmedzujú a kontrolujú prístup na externé stránky, aby sa predišlo bezpečnostným hrozbám, ako je napríklad infikovanie malvérom pri prístupe na nebezpečné stránky.

Name: Protection against DoS and DDoS attacks
Notes: Technologies, processes, and strategies are implemented to detect and mitigate DoS and DDoS attacks, ensuring that essential services remain available. This includes leveraging network-level defenses, application-layer protections, and proactive monitoring to prevent service disruptions.
EN Name: Protection against DoS and DDoS attacks
EN Notes: Technologies, processes, and strategies are implemented to detect and mitigate DoS and DDoS attacks, ensuring that essential services remain available. This includes leveraging network-level defenses, application-layer protections, and proactive monitoring to prevent service disruptions.
SK Name: Ochrana proti DoS a DDoS útokom
SK Notes: Implementujú sa technológie, procesy a stratégie na detekciu a zmiernenie útokov DoS a DDoS, čím sa zabezpečuje dostupnosť kľúčových služieb. To zahŕňa využívanie obrany na úrovni siete, ochrany na aplikačnej úrovni a proaktívne monitorovanie na prevenciu výpadkov služieb.

Name: Blocking communication and connection through unauthorized ports
Notes: Setting network and communication security by blocking unauthorized connections from sources identified as malicious or threatening, if the system configuration allows for it.
EN Name: Blocking communication and connection through unauthorized ports
EN Notes: Setting network and communication security by blocking unauthorized connections from sources identified as malicious or threatening, if the system configuration allows for it.
SK Name: Blokovanie komunikácie a pripojenia cez neoprávnené porty
SK Notes: Nastavenie bezpečnosti siete a komunikácie blokovaním neoprávnených pripojení zo zdrojov identifikovaných ako škodlivé alebo hrozivé, ak to konfigurácia systému umožňuje.

Name: Content filtering
Notes: Outbound user network traffic routed through content filtering server.
EN Notes: Outbound user network traffic routed through content filtering server.
SK Notes: Odchádzajúca sieťová komunikácia používateľov prechádza cez server na filtrovanie obsahu.

Name: Information transfer policies, procedures and agreements
Notes: Setting up security on all user devices. Measures must be taken to protect the devices from malicious software and other threats.
EN Name: Information transfer policies, procedures and agreements
EN Notes: Setting up security on all user devices. Measures must be taken to protect the devices from malicious software and other threats.
SK Name: Politiky, postupy a dohody o prenose a výmene informácií
SK Notes: Nastavenie bezpečnosti na všetkých zariadeniach používateľov. Prijatie opatrení na ochranu zariadení pred škodlivým softvérom a inými hrozbami.

Name: Email security (DMARC, SPF, DKIM)
Notes: Email security is enforced using DMARC (Domain-based Message Authentication Reporting and Conformance), SPF (Sender Policy Framework), and DKIM (DomainKeys Identified Mail) authentication methods. They help prevent spammers, phishers, and other unauthorized parties from sending emails on behalf of a "domain" they do not own.
EN Notes: Email security is enforced using DMARC (Domain-based Message Authentication Reporting and Conformance), SPF (Sender Policy Framework), and DKIM (DomainKeys Identified Mail) authentication methods. They help prevent spammers, phishers, and other unauthorized parties from sending emails on behalf of a "domain" they do not own.
SK Notes: Bezpečnosť e-mailov je zabezpečená pomocou metód autentifikácie DMARC (Domain-based Message Authentication Reporting and Conformance), SPF (Sender Policy Framework) a DKIM (DomainKeys Identified Mail). Tieto metódy pomáhajú zabrániť spammerom, phishingovým útokom a iným neoprávneným osobám posielať e-maily v mene domény, ktorú nevlastnia.

Name: S/MIME - Email encryption
Notes: S/MIME is used to encrypt email content and digitally sign messages, ensuring that sensitive email communications are protected from unauthorized access and tampering. S/MIME certificates are managed securely, and users are trained in their use and maintenance.
EN Notes: S/MIME is used to encrypt email content and digitally sign messages, ensuring that sensitive email communications are protected from unauthorized access and tampering. S/MIME certificates are managed securely, and users are trained in their use and maintenance.
SK Notes: S/MIME sa používa na šifrovanie obsahu e-mailov a digitálne podpisovanie správ, čím zabezpečuje ochranu citlivých e-mailových komunikácií pred neoprávneným prístupom a manipuláciou. S/MIME certifikáty sú spravované bezpečne a používatelia sú školení v ich používaní a údržbe.

Name: Confidentiality or nondisclosure agreements (NDA)
Notes: Implementing measures to protect confidential information from unauthorized disclosure. This includes establishing confidentiality agreements with stakeholders and employees.
EN Notes: Implementing measures to protect confidential information from unauthorized disclosure. This includes establishing confidentiality agreements with stakeholders and employees.
SK Notes: Implementácia opatrení na ochranu dôverných informácií pred neoprávneným zverejnením. To zahŕňa vytvorenie dohôd o mlčanlivosti s účastníkmi a zamestnancami.

Name: Securing application services on public networks
Notes: The information involved in application services passing over public networks need to be protected from fraudulent activity, contract dispute and unauthorised disclosure and modification. The requirements cover a wide range of topics, including security policy, risk assessment, security control objectives, and implementation considerations. Implementing and applying information security requirements for applications during their development, use, and acquisition. It ensures that security measures are integrated into the life cycle of applications. An example is the use of authorization,m VPN, data transmission encryption, etc.
EN Name: Securing application services on public networks
EN Notes: The information involved in application services passing over public networks need to be protected from fraudulent activity, contract dispute and unauthorised disclosure and modification.
